title: Power Circuit
description: Powerful 6-exercise circuit: squats, commando push-ups, curtsy lunges and burpees

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Fast marching in place
exercises.instructions: March quickly in place while swinging the arms

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart, lower thighs parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Commando push-ups
exercises.instructions: Alternate between forearm plank and high plank position

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: On the forearms, body perfectly aligned, brace the core

exercises.name: Burpees without push-up
exercises.instructions: Drop down, jump feet back, return, jump up

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift the shoulders, brace the abs

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, pivot the body

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
